title: Three Mornings and One Short Broom
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（人与自我·做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（人与自我·做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：housework　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 housework 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the mother ① shared the housework that no brother in the flat would have described, and he said the sharing was the whole of the Tuesday. The ② housework, meaning the chore itself and not the broom, ran three Tuesdays and stayed undescribed in the book; a housework, he said, is the only thing in a flat that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ housework in that flat had the same short broom beside it, and the ④ housework at the far sink, meaning the task they kept for the children to finish and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A housework, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the mother said the describing is the part that fills three Tuesdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the housework was the whole of the matter, meaning the share and not the chore. The ⑥ housework, meaning the share and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; housework, he said, is either something you share or the only word that means both a chore and a share. He said the share is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ housework had become a line in a account, and the account had become an argument about the short broom. The ⑧ housework of the whole thing, the mother wrote in May, was one flat and three Tuesdays of describing; housework, he said, is either the task at the far sink or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ housework I remember is the chore described in the account, which closed in 1964 and is still described as the quietest in the flat. A ⑩ housework, my mother said in 1966, is the only chore that improves by being described; every housework, she said, is a share that has agreed to look like a chore. She said the share was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 家务活（指公寓里每一件旁边的那一件）
B. n. 家务活（指那件家务活本身，与扫帚相对）
C. 固定搭配：share the housework 分担家务
D. n. 家务活（指留给孩子们做完的那一件）
E. n. 家务之事（抽象总称，指一处公寓的家务之事）
F. n. 家务活（指账目里写到、被记下的的那一件）
G. n. 分担、责任（指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 责任（抽象总称，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: share the housework 意为“分担家务”，1957 年那位母亲把公寓里没有一位弟弟肯描述的一件家务做了一遍。
housework 意为“家务活”，指那件家务活本身而不是扫帚，它经过了三个星期二而在簿子上没有被描述。
housework 意为“家务活”，指公寓里每一件旁边的那一件，每一件旁边都有同一把短短的扫帚。
housework 意为“家务活”，指最远那个水槽留给孩子们做完的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
housework 意为“分担、责任”，指一件事里人人都做却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份分担就是那件事的全部。
housework 意为“责任”，指人人都做却无人提起的那样东西而不是那件家务活，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
housework 意为“家务活”，指账目里写到、被记下的的那一件，到 1962 年这一件成了账目里的一行。
housework 意为“家务之事”，母亲五月写道，整件事的家务之事是一处公寓和三个星期二的描述。
housework 意为“家务活”，我记得的是账目里描述过的那一件，1964 年做完了，至今仍被说成公寓里最安静的一件。
housework 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，家务是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的家务活。
